name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_<domain=ui>_<descriptor>; _template correctly reflects the copy-source role and the array data type. No Ghidra address residue (game_options is semantic, not a hex suffix of its own address). Consistent with the established sibling *_menu_state_template family (field_command @ 0x53EF2, player_action @ 0x53F12, save_load @ 0x53F22).
purpose: Zero-init per-option enable/disable flag template for the game-options (settings) menu; copied into a local menu_state[16] buffer that gates which of the 4 options (BGM/SE/Speed/Other) are selectable.
logic_summary: 4 x int32, all 0. Sole reader fd2_game_options_menu_loop (@ 0x16FDD) copies all four 32-bit words from 0x53F02 into a local menu_state[16] stack buffer via a count-4 REP MOVSD (MOV ECX,4; MOV ESI,0x53F02; REP MOVSD), then passes that local buffer to fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step, which read the per-option flags (EBX[0/4/8/0xc]) on the local copy to skip greyed-out options. All-zero template means all four options are always selectable. The global source is never mutated; only the local copy is.
element_semantics: Four per-option gating flags, one int32 per menu option [0]=BGM, [1]=SE, [2]=Speed, [3]=Other; 0 = selectable, non-zero = greyed-out/disabled. All 0 statically.
notes: Data symbol (no function plate; get_plate_comment correctly reports 'No function at address'). Memory is 16 bytes of zeros in .object2 (writable/BSS zero-init). is_const=false: zero game write-xrefs (only READ @0x172b8 + DATA pointer-form @0x172b3), but the existing decl is already non-const int32 and the whole *_menu_state_template sibling family is uniformly non-const (.object2) in deliberate contrast to the truly-const *_menu_slots_template / *_menu_options_template label families (const data @0x51EXX). Keeping non-const matches both its segment and its family, so the existing declaration is correct -- no change. comment_verdict=keep: existing block (uitab.c lines 195-210) is accurate, ASCII, concise, correctly documents purpose + REP MOVSD copy + consumer gating + all-zero/never-written rationale + sibling cross-ref; nothing stale. No src edit needed. ghidra_plate_action=none: the 'fixup to -> 00003f02' line in the decompiler is auto-generated, not a data plate; src comment is source of truth and no contradicting plate exists to fix.
